connector.name: Nevent MCP
connector.registryDescription: Talk to your live-events CRM (campaigns, analytics, paid ads, segments) in Claude and ChatGPT.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.nevent.ai over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp-nevent. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the nevent-dev account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: NEVENT_JWT_TOKEN
env.description: Nevent JWT access token for authenticating with the Nevent API

env.name: NEVENT_OPERATION_MODE
env.description: Tool operation mode: READ_ONLY (default), STANDARD, or FULL
